title: Tim Dooley — Political Alignment Map
status: canonical reader-support record; descriptive, non-electoral, non-scoring
purpose: Describe Tim Dooley's recovered political alignment without forcing it into a synthetic two-axis score. Preserve Tim's own self-labels separately from archive synthesis and show the recurring tensions that make the position difficult to reduce to conventional left/right categories.

method.rule: Use dated Tim-originated positions where available. Archive synthesis may connect recurring positions but must remain labeled as synthesis.
method.no_score: No numeric political-compass coordinate is assigned. The corpus is multidimensional, developmental and incomplete.
method.political_boundary: This record describes Tim's positions; it does not recommend a party, candidate or vote.

self_descriptions.wording: Tim considers himself radically centered, where he took the best from the left and from the right.
he is cioonseervative lftist, h is radical centeer.
self_descriptions.status: user-originated description of Tim's political view

self_descriptions.wording: tim dooley says i can easily be left... while simultaneously... have a conservative outlook on the economy
self_descriptions.implication: Left social commitments and a conservative/fiscally disciplined economic temperament are treated as compatible rather than contradictory.

alignment_axes.boundary: Tim does not resolve into doctrinaire laissez-faire capitalism, state socialism or communism. He repeatedly prefers mechanisms by function and outcome.

substance: retain or expand investment that builds durable capability
alignment_axes.tension: Fiscal conservatism is not treated as an instruction to liquidate productive public capacity.

alignment_axes.recovered_orientation: lean-capable rather than simply small or large
substance: AI as coordination/audit tool rather than independent sovereign
alignment_axes.boundary: Capability does not itself create legitimacy.

alignment_axes.tension: Individual freedom is defended, but freedom is not treated as permission to externalize unlimited harm.
Tim values Denmark's communal 'we' while also criticizing excessive suppression of the 'me'.
Sovereignty is not isolation; integration is not automatic absorption.

developmental_roots: 2026-01-21 Axis of Protection and Growth around Greenland/Denmark/Nordics
2026-02-14 defence-burden shift: more European defence can allow reduced U.S. burden
2026-03-18 onward Europe/Canada/North becomes an explicit geopolitical topology

alignment_axes.recovered_orientation: reformist distance rather than simple hostility
substance: reduced European dependence on U.S. security
alignment_axes.tension: America may remain a partner, but Tim rejects one-way dependency or entitlement to hegemonic privilege without corresponding obligations.

substance: opposition to domination and self-justifying institutional expansion
alignment_axes.boundary: The corpus does not support simple pacifism, militarism or a settled NATO-abolition doctrine.

substance: AI for audit and bureaucracy debugging
alignment_axes.tension: Tim is strongly pro-capability but wary of opaque structural dependence on a single external platform or contractor.

alignment_axes.recovered_orientation: abundance and resilience rather than purity
alignment_axes.boundary: The through-line is strategic resilience and productive capacity, not loyalty to one fuel ideology.

substance: serious noncitizen criminality or espionage can justify lawful deportation

alignment_axes.tension: Conflict language can be severe, but mature programme design emphasizes repair, measurable outcomes and non-collective blame.

synthesis.concise_description: A mixed-economy, socially protective, fiscally disciplined, liberty-conscious and development-oriented radical center: pro-market but not anti-public-sector; pro-sovereignty but pro-deep cooperation; pro-defence but anti-domination; pro-technology but anti-dependency; communitarian without erasing individuality.

recurring_tensions: left social commitments ↔ conservative fiscal discipline
technology/AI acceleration ↔ data and infrastructure sovereignty
institutional skepticism ↔ desire for capable public institutions
communal Denmark ↔ protection of individual distinctness
unresolved: universal basic income as settled doctrine
